player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nessunu formatu de mogura balidu agatadu. Imprea [a1b2], p.es. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Su ruju no at pius pezas, su nieddu bìnchit!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Su nieddu no tenet pius pezas, su ruju bìnchit!
outcome.no_moves: Su giogadore {player_id} no tenet prus movidas.
outcome.draw: Su lìmite de curva est istadu cròmpidu.
